metadata.siteDescription: Conversational commerce for informal merchants, freelancers, and service providers in Zambia. Automate orders, secure payments, and coordinate delivery through one lightweight experience.

hero.description: Conversational commerce for informal merchants, freelancers, and service providers in Zambia. Automate orders, secure payments, and coordinate delivery through one lightweight experience.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Informal commerce is held back by manual chaos

scatteredChannels.title: Scattered Channels
scatteredChannels.description: Orders come through WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram DMs with no single system tracking them all.

slowResponseTimes.title: Slow Response Times
slowResponseTimes.description: Customers wait too long for availability and pricing updates, so sales drop before the vendor replies.

transactionTrust.title: No Transaction Trust
transactionTrust.description: Payments are often made upfront without escrow, receipts, or a reliable way to resolve disputes.

fulfilmentStructure.title: No Fulfilment Structure
fulfilmentStructure.description: Delivery is coordinated manually by phone, which creates missed orders and weak visibility.

features.label: Platform Scope
features.title: Built for every role in the ecosystem

chatDemo.label: Core Feature Demo
chatDemo.title: Try the conversational ordering flow
chatDemo.intro: Customers can complete an entire order through automated chat, from availability and item selection to delivery scheduling and payment confirmation.

escrow.label: Trust Engine
escrow.title: Escrow-protected every step of the way
escrow.description: Funds are held securely until delivery is confirmed. Neither party can be defrauded, which makes the ordering flow easier to trust for both sides.

placed.title: Order Placed
placed.description: Customer completes checkout through the conversational flow. The order is created and marked as pending payment.

payment.title: Payment Initiated
payment.description: Customer pays via Airtel Money or MTN MoMo. Payment confirmation is sent to the platform.

held.title: Funds in Escrow
held.description: Payment is received and held securely in escrow. Neither the seller nor the customer can access it yet.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.description: The seller accepts the order and begins preparing it. Status updates are sent to the customer automatically.

delivery.title: Out for Delivery
delivery.description: The order is handed to the courier or prepared for customer pickup. The customer receives tracking updates and an ETA.

pin.title: PIN Verification
pin.description: Customer receives a secure delivery PIN. The courier must get the PIN from the customer to confirm successful delivery.

released.title: Funds Released
released.description: PIN confirmed. Funds are released from escrow to the seller wallet and both parties receive confirmation.

frontend.name: Next.js + React
frontend.note: Shared routes for the phone-shell app, auth pages, and project hub.

styling.name: Tailwind CSS
styling.note: Rapid, consistent styling with reusable surfaces and utility-driven polish.

state.name: Context + hooks
state.note: Lightweight global state for cart, checkout, chat, and storefront panels.

routing.name: App Router
routing.note: Supports app preview, auth, hub, and future vendor dashboard routes.

backend.name: Supabase
backend.note: Recommended path for PostgreSQL, auth, storage, and real-time messaging.

hosting.name: Vercel
hosting.note: Fast deployment path for demo environments and stakeholder reviews.

payments.name: Mobile Money
payments.note: Airtel Money and MTN MoMo flows are mocked in this POC checkout.

data.name: Static JSON
data.note: Product, feed, and bot flows remain front-end controlled for fast iteration.

weekOne.description: Frontend setup, shared UI architecture, storefront browsing

weekTwo.description: Conversational flow, cart, checkout, escrow simulation

weekThree.description: Refinement, docs, testing, and stakeholder walkthroughs
